SUPERVISOR — SCULPTSPLIT-0606 design RULINGS (user):

Q1 answered with a LAYOUT RULING that supersedes the side-by-side divider entirely, verbatim: "put everything on the same interface. put the mesh up top and then a row of the two other tools below it. this side by side column approach is ass." So: VERTICAL STACK — the 3D mesh view on TOP (full width), and below it ONE ROW holding the two other tools (the unwrap canvas + the sculpt toolset/samples). The drag-divider work re-orients to this stack (top/bottom split) or simplifies away — side-by-side columns are dead on this lens. (The original depth-read question went unanswered — your default Q1(b) contours may ride, low ceremony, user can veto on sight.)
Q2: ALWAYS-ON faint lattice — "keep the lattice on, there is no reason to not."
Q3: circle + mode tint (your default).
Q4: smart — smooth at rest, chunky while the grid overlay is on (your default).

Land it as the layout restructure + the three visual treatments; Stage.tsx is clear now (CLOTHSPLIT landed); resolve req_0057 with these shas. READY FOR USER TEST.
